gold_standard: Uploaded Algebra Unit 1 Activity Options package preserved by the Framework reference CSS mirrors.
legacy_reference_rule: activity_projector.css is reference/legacy only. Hub and projection decks use activities.css. Do not load both.

hub_contract.required_behavior: Every activity NAME links to its projectable directions anchor inside the same hub HTML; Set 1/Set 2 links open reusable companion decks/files; Tarsia links do not imply duplicated Tarsia content.
hub_contract.directions: Directions sections/pages follow the menu inside the same hub HTML and each has a stable unique id.

projection_contract.figure_rule: Prompt text must precede the supporting representation in DOM order. Use canonical Bank figures after the prompt.
projection_contract.table_rule: Ordinary small/two-column tables are compact and centered; do not inherit full-page table width.

stations_contract.answer_page: each station question page followed immediately by its answer page
stations_contract.classroom_copy_sequence: Use six unique station pages covering all 24 questions; repeat the six-station + answers sequence once only if the current printable gold-standard copy workflow requests duplicate classroom copies.

find_someone_who_contract.purpose: printable movement + peer-interaction worksheet/record format using the same canonical set
